items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think it was Buddy Colette and Moral Young; I think he drew up the conditions under which we were to amalgamate.

ctx.x: I don’t know. We had a series of meetings and, you know, finally, I think it was Buddy Colette and Moral Young; I think he drew up the conditions under which we were to amalgamate. They voted on it, and it was passed overwhelmingly.
This is the members of both unions.
